comparison.objective: Seal a filled press-to-seal bag across its entire track.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual stabilization with a continuous pinch-slide along a flexible closure.
comparison.success_condition: All 16 cells closed without excessive bag motion or spill, then hands clear for one second.
comparison.reason: Pinch-sliding a closure is not coupled rotary adjustment and countertorque locking.
